reason: C0 is a decoupling/charge-holding capacitor on the internal clock/bias node net69; removing it typically keeps functionality but reduces filtering and makes net69 more susceptible to switching noise.
impact_estimate: Low (more ripple/kickback on net69; possible small noise/metastability penalty).

reason: M1 only discharges/clamps net69 to VSS when VCLK2 is active; if net69 is already strongly controlled by M11 and the clocking network, M1 is often redundant and mainly improves reset speed/robustness.
impact_estimate: Low-to-moderate (slower net69 discharge/reset; may increase memory effects across cycles).

reason: M8 is a precharge/pull-up device that biases net60 from VDD under VCLK1; if the input NMOS (M10) and the PMOS/load path (M14/M12/M0) provide sufficient restoration, removing M8 mainly reduces precharge strength rather than breaking operation.
impact_estimate: Moderate (weaker/slow net60 precharge; could degrade speed or input-referred offset depending on timing).
